title: Api
description: The app backend's replies, for generating the frontend's types.

point.description: One operating point as a time-domain sweep streams it.

Band.description: One ⅓-octave band (IEC 61260 base-ten centres) and whether the model resolves it.

reasons.description: Why it is not resolved; empty when it is.

measured_db.description:
Measured level, dB re 20 µPa, corrected for the background when one is given; `None`
where the recording cannot give it.

note.description: Why the measured level is missing or corrected.

target_db.description: Indicative target, ± dB (shown, not passed or failed): 3 up to 2 kHz, 5 above.

CaseReport.description: A case run on demand: its checks, or why it did not run.

contacts.description: Stretches closer than the gap wanted there.

Contact.description: A stretch of pipe closer to the underbody than wanted.

at.description: Where it is closest, on the centreline and on the scan.

from_mm.description: Along the centreline from the route's start, mm.

zone.description: The clearance zone that set the gap, if one did.

CycleProgress.description:
A time-domain point in progress: engine cycles run, and how far the last differs from the
one before (the periodicity residual; `None` after the first).

cruise_peak.description: Highest level in the cruise band, `[rpm, dB]`; `None` without points in the band.

minus_3db_rpm.description:
Speeds below and above the peak where the track is 3 dB down; `None` where it stays
within 3 dB to the end of the sweep.

track.description: Firing-order level per solved speed: `[rpm, dB]`.

unconverged_rpm.description: Speeds in the track whose time-domain run did not reach periodicity.

body.description: Outer envelope as coaxial frustums (cones and cylinders).

EvoSource.description: Where the in-cylinder state at EVO came from.

oneOf.description: Ideal Otto-cycle estimate at this manifold pressure.
`operating.evo_override`.

EvoState.description: In-cylinder state at exhaust valve opening.

ends.description: The ends swept: values for a number, scale factors otherwise.

error.description: Neither end could be built: the input is outside the band.

impact_db.description: Largest change in the resolved bands within 40 dB of the loudest, dB.

low_db.description: Level change at the low and the high end, per band, dB.

note.description: One end could not be built: why, the other end standing for both.

InputUse.description: A recorded input as a result reports it.

default_range.description: The range is its class's default, not a stated one.

Limiter.description: TVD slope limiter for MUSCL reconstruction of primitive variables.

oneOf.description: `minmod(a, b)`: most dissipative TVD limiter.
van Leer (1974): `2ab/(a + b)` when `ab > 0`.

van Leer with a TVB bound (Shu 1987): where both one-sided differences are below
`gas1d::TVB_BOUND` of the local ρ, c or p the profile is treated as smooth and
reconstructed unlimited with the third-order upwind-biased MUSCL κ = 1/3 formula;
elsewhere (engine pulses, shocks, contact jumps) the van Leer limiter applies. Strict
TVD limiters flatten every acoustic extremum; over 2 m of pipe at Δx = 15 mm and 19 cells
per wavelength van Leer loses 10 dB at 1.2 kHz, this variant 2 dB (0.2 dB in exhaust gas).

Line.description: One spectral line at the receiver.

order.description: Engine order (multiples of ½ for a four-stroke).

phase_rad.description: Phase of the receiver pressure, rad (`e^{jωt}`, t = 0 at cylinder 1 firing TDC).

Listener.description:
Who hears the scene. Positions are in the vehicle frame (X forward, Y left, Z up, origin at
the downpipe flange), mm.

oneOf.description: The project's receiver: one channel.

A head at the receiver, facing the reference outlet turned `turn_deg` to the left (90:
the outlet at the right ear), ears `ear_spacing_mm` apart on the horizontal line across
the facing: two channels, left ear first. Each ear is a free-field point; the head's
shadow is not modelled.
Microphones at rest beside the vehicle: one channel each.

The vehicle drives along its +x axis past a microphone at rest. `mic_mm` is in the
frame the vehicle frame coincides with after travelling 0; the vehicle frame starts at
`start_mm` along x and moves at `speed_kmh` against time, `[[t_s, km/h], …]`.
The driver's ear: the receiver's pressure through the measured cabin transfer function.

ports.description: Fixed ports; a chamber adds `out2`, `out3`, … for its extra outlets.

type.description: Element type, as in the project file.

drone_interior.description: Through the measured cabin transfer function; `None` without one.

OrderDifference.description: An engine order of two solved configurations, `b − a`.

cruise_db.description: Mean level difference over the cruise band, at speeds both solved, dB.

largest.description: The largest difference either way over the sweep, `[rpm, dB]`.

peak_db.description: Highest level over the sweep, of `a` and of `b`, dB.

level_db.description: Per speed bin; `None` where the recording has no frame.

OrderTracks.description: Levels of engine orders against engine speed from a recording.

calibrated.description: Levels in dB re 20 µPa; otherwise dB re full scale.

drone.description: The firing order's drone, as reported for the prediction.

frames.description: Frames analysed and frames within the sweep.

rpm_estimated.description: Engine speed estimated from the recording, without a log.

key.description: Field name in the project file.

unit.description: Numbers only: unit, inclusive range, and the editor's default.

oneOf.description: A material id from the project's table.
A direction in vehicle coordinates (normalised on use).
Offsets from a port, mm, one per extra port.

from.description: What each end is welded or joined to.

hangers_mm.description: Hangers, mm from this straight's start.
Hangers, mm of arc from this bend's start.

rotation_deg.description: From the previous bend's plane; absent for a route's first bend.

stock_deg.description: Stock bend it is cut from, degrees.

turns_toward.description: Direction the tube turns toward (first bend's placement), unit vector.

oneOf.description:
A tube off the main pipe (a stub, a Helmholtz neck), one end coped to saddle the main
pipe. Cut to `length_mm` (its long side); the cope reaches `saddle_mm` below the crown,
where the branch axis leaves the main pipe's outer wall and the modelled length starts.

main_od_mm.description: The main pipe the cope fits, and the angle from its flow direction to the branch.

PieceLayout.description: A piece of centreline starting `s0_mm` along its route.

oneOf.description: Constant-radius arc from `from` to `to` about `centre`.

residual_mm.description: RMS distance between the reference points as placed and as given, mm.

PointOutcome.description: A point either solved or failed; failures carry the reason and no numbers.

backpressure_pa.description: Mean static pressure above ambient at the downpipe flange, Pa (time domain only).

mass_balance_error.description: |outlet mass − source mass| / source mass over the analysed cycles (time domain only).

outlet_temperature_k.description: Mean gas temperature leaving the reference outlet, K.

Provenance.description: How a result was produced; attached to every result.

small_signal.description:
Four-pole result of a network with elements that are nonlinear at exhaust amplitudes
(valves, orifices): valid for small signals only.

thermal_profile.description: Wall and gas temperature model, with a BLAKE3 hash of its inputs.

time_domain.description: Time-domain run details; absent for four-pole results.

warnings.description: Modelling limitations that affect this result.

Provenance2.description: Where a value comes from, in order of precedence.

oneOf.description: Measured on the vehicle or its parts.
A manufacturer's specification, a standard, or a cited publication.
Computed from other inputs.
Estimated: memory, forum figures, a placeholder, or a rule of thumb.

RecordingComparison.description:
A window of a calibrated recording set against a render of the same engine speed at the
same place. Recordings validate; nothing here is fed back into an input.

rpm.description: Engine speed over the window: mean and standard deviation, rpm.

rpm_estimated.description: Engine speed estimated from the recording, without a log.

window_s.description: The window checked, s from the recording's start (at most 20 s).

cfl_max.description: Largest Courant number of any step of the scene.

default_ranges.description: Of those, how many take their class's default range.

inputs.description: Every recorded input with its provenance, source and range.

leq_db.description: Equivalent continuous level of each channel, dB re 20 µPa.

pre_roll_s.description: Engine held at the start state before t = 0 so every listener hears it from t = 0, s.

source.description: Engine source model and where its EVO states come from.

start.description: The periodic state the scene starts from.

oneOf.description: Settling the network at the scene's start.
Marching the scene: fraction of the recorded time done.

bend_radius_mm.description: Centreline radius of the bend at each via point.

length_mm.description: Centreline length: the flow solver's x-axis along this route.

points.description: Start port, via points, end port.

RouteParts.description:
The parts of a route, or of an element's own tube (`stub/tube`, `helmholtz/neck`,
`helmholtz/can`), from its start.

Scene.description: What the render plays: engine speed and load against time, and who hears it.

map_kpa.description:
Intake manifold pressure against time, `[[t_s, kPa], …]` (a throttle trace); absent:
the project's load line `operating.map_kpa` at the engine speed of the moment.

rpm.description: Engine speed against time, `[[t_s, rpm], …]`, linear between points, held outside.

base_db.description:
Receiver level with every input as recorded, dB re 20 µPa; `None` above the samples'
Nyquist frequency or where nothing sounds.

combined_db.description: Root-sum-square over the inputs of each one's larger change, dB.

inputs.description: Inputs on their class's default range first, then by impact.

limit_hz.description:
Bands above this frequency, Hz, are beyond the model (`render::Limits`); impacts are
taken below it.

SpectrogramDifference.description:
Predicted less measured level in each ⅓-octave band of each frame (Hann, `frame_s` long,
every half frame).

difference_db.description:
Per frame, per band (`render::third_octaves`), dB; `None` where either level is
missing or below the recording's resolution.

times_s.description: Frame centres, s from the window's start.

Stick.description: One stock length of tube and the straights cut from it.

TimeDomainRun.description: Scheme and convergence of a time-domain run.

period_cycles.description: Period of the solution in engine cycles (1 or 2).

periodicity_residual.description:
Largest relative change of the monitored signals between the last cycle and the cycle
one period earlier.

band.description:
The value for the hottest and for the coolest branch gas; absent when the walls are not
computed and no temperature is stated.

basis.description: Where the branch gas temperature comes from.

branch_temperature_k.description: Mean branch gas temperature at each value (nominal, then hottest and coolest), K.

rpm.description: Engine speed whose thermal state the branch gas takes.

Uncertainty.description: How far a value may be from the truth.

oneOf.description: Anywhere in `[low, high]`, in the field's unit.
Within ± `fraction` of the value.
Within ± `plus_minus` of the value, in the field's unit.
Between the value / `factor` and the value × `factor`.

between.description: The two things joined (part ids or `element.port`).

note.description: Filler or method needed for the metals meeting here.
